subject: Question about the tea gift box
body: Hi, I was in your Wenzhou Lucheng store a few days ago looking at the tea gift boxes and I'm trying to remember which one I saw. It had a sort of green and gold box, I think there were several kinds of tea inside, and the person helping me mentioned it was one of the more popular ones. I meant to write down the name but didn't, and now I can't find it on your website. Could you tell me which box that might be? I'd like to order a couple as gifts if it's still available. Thanks.
